name: Zebrafish tailbud, light-sheet time-lapse
description: Light-sheet time-lapse of a zebrafish tailbud from the 22-somite stage with H2B-GFP nuclei, 79 time points 2 minutes apart, each a 201-plane z-stack, as OME-Zarr; opens at the middle time point, and Play under Time point shows the tail growing and somites forming. The image is a 333-pixel preview with no recorded pixel size, so the scale bar assumes 1 µm per pixel.

source.citation: Attardi A et al. (2018) Neuromesodermal progenitors are a conserved source of spinal cord with divergent growth dynamics. Development 145(21):dev166728. doi:10.1242/dev.166728
